meta.name: context-doc
meta.description: Build CONTEXT.md (domain glossary) + docs/adr/ via interview; keeps agent vocab aligned. Triggers "domain language", "glossary", "ADR", inconsistent terminology.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 访谈构建领域术语与决策文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要统一领域术语并记录关键架构决策。
copy.tagline_en: Build domain glossary and ADRs through interviews
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to align domain vocabulary and document key architecture decisions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会通过提问帮你整理项目中的专有词汇，生成CONTEXT.md术语表；遇到难撤销的决策时，还会记录架构决策到docs/adr/文件夹。
howto.when: 当你提到“术语”、“词汇表”、“架构决策”，或使用与已有定义矛盾的词语时触发。

say.text: 帮我给「用户」这个词下个准确定义。
我们考虑用微服务拆分订单系统，记一个ADR。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude interviews you to build a project glossary (CONTEXT.md) and captures hard-to-reverse trade-offs as architecture decision records in docs/adr/, keeping terminology consistent across sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "domain language", "glossary", "ADR", or use terms that conflict with existing definitions.

say_en.text: Help me define the term "User" precisely.
say_en.note: Claude will probe and update glossary.

say_en.text: Consider splitting order system into microservices, capture an ADR.
